create_dataset_make_blobs: create a separable two-class dataset using make_blobs with 40 samples and 2 centers
build_svm_classifier: build an SVM classifier with linear kernel and C=1000 using sklearn.svm.SVC
fit_svm_model: fit the SVM classifier on the dataset to learn the separating hyperplane
plot_decision_boundary: plot the decision boundary contours and support vectors of a fitted SVM model
scatter_data_points: scatter plot the dataset points colored by class using matplotlib.pyplot.scatter
